Rina: Follow-up: postmortem action sync for failover. Need clear owners for three remediation tracks: routing diagnostics, backup validation, and game-day dry runs.

Omar: I'll take routing diagnostics. Plan: create an interactive routing heatmap + short root-cause timeline. ETA Wed.

Tess: I'll do backup validation & open tickets for lifecycle rules. ETA Fri.

Rina: We also need to track recurring incident signatures (same prefix churn pattern across 3 incidents). Omar can you list those incidents?

Omar: Yes, list incoming. I'll cross-ref with BGP logs and add a small graph.

InfraBot: Note: backup verification scripts located at /ops/scripts/backup_verify.sh.

Tess: Quick question  embeddings store restore time is currently ~3.5h in dry runs. We should discuss extra snapshot cadence.

Rina: Good to flag in postmortem. We'll treat embedding-store as a candidate for expedited snapshots.

Omar: For game-day suggestions: simulate partial AZ + delayed inter-region BGP propagation, and verify RTO targets for auth-db and embeddings-store.

Tess: I'll include a table mapping service -> current RTO -> recommended RTO.

Rina: Action items: Omar (routing heatmap + incident list) due 2026-04-02, Tess (backup validation + tickets) due 2026-04-01, Rina (game-day schedule) due 2026-04-05.

Omar: Will also add a brief blameless note about noisy BGP peer flaps.

Tess: Opening tickets now for any lifecycle rules violating retention policy.

InfraBot: Reminder: next postmortem review meeting scheduled 2026-04-06.

Rina: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the drafts.
